stories.headline: Støre visits Kyiv on invasion anniversary, announces 12 billion NOK drone support package
stories.summary: Prime Minister Jonas Gahr Støre visited Kyiv on February 24, marking the 4th anniversary of Russia's invasion. He announced 12 billion NOK for drones and unmanned systems, met with President Zelensky, and signed a strategic partnership agreement. The visit included stops at Ukrainian training camps in Poland.

stories.headline: King Harald hospitalized in Spain with infection, discharged after treatment
stories.summary: 89-year-old King Harald was hospitalized in Tenerife on February 24 while on vacation with Queen Sonja. He was treated for a skin infection and dehydration. His personal physician traveled to Spain, and he was discharged on February 26, continuing his vacation in the Canary Islands.

stories.headline: Finance Minister Stoltenberg adjusts housing wealth tax, raises threshold to 14 million NOK
stories.summary: Finance Minister Jens Stoltenberg held press conferences announcing adjustments to the controversial housing wealth tax model. The threshold for what constitutes expensive housing was raised from 10 to 14 million NOK, affecting fewer properties and addressing criticism of the 'tax bomb.'
